name: Leviathan
brief: A large sea creature mentioned in the Bible
short: Leviathan is a large sea creature mentioned in several Old Testament passages, often associated with chaos, evil, or God's power over creation (<ref="Job.3.8; 41:1; Psalm 74:14; 104:26; Isaiah 27:1">Job.3.8; 41:1; Psalm 74:14; 104:26; Isaiah 27:1</ref>).
